notes.title: Fixes from 21.07.2025 – Eternal Sorrow and minor bugs.
notes.content:
Fixed a critical bug during the ending dialogue (Thanks, Vladddc).
Additionally, minor bugs reported by players have been fixed and verified.

Thanks, everyone!

I continue working—one of the next big steps is adding new languages.

notes.title: Hotfix 27.06.2025 - The Very Silent Grandpa
notes.content:
Thanks to gedenteen for finding yet another hardlock ːsteamthumbsupː
It's been fixed, but there's a [b]catch[/b]. We've reworked this character's quest system. If you're starting a new game, everything should work fine. But if you're continuing a saved game, there's a small chance the character might not appear in this location (though he probably will).

notes.title: Hotfix 06/26/2025
notes.content: Fixed a batch of minor bugs. Improved English localization in several sections

notes.title: Update 06/25/2025 – Black Thursday
notes.content: Fixed the black screen freeze at the end of Thursday.

notes.title: November update of the “Hello your order” demo version
notes.content:
Hi!
Thanks to everyone who played the demo version of my project.

Your feedback helped to catch a few bugs and understand where players can get confused and ruin their gaming experience a bit.

Also thanks to the people who played on the streams and made vids - there are not many of you, but you are there :)

Also in the demo were added a couple of new systems, redesigned the system of displaying streets and stops. And added a system of intercoms. 

Before the release with high probability will be 1-2 more major updates. 

Peace.
